rules.statement: A bond hypothecating money as security for costs must be executed before the Judge, Secretary or Chief Clerk in accordance with section 757 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: "This bond has not been executed either before the Judge or the Secretary and therefore section 756 (1) read with section 757 has not been complied with."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 757 of the Civil Procedure Code.
